title: You have been lied about Kerala
description:
Everyone calls Kerala the “model state” — high literacy, great healthcare, progressive thinking. But behind the praise lies a growing list of problems nobody talks about.

Rising unemployment, educated youth leaving the state, economic slowdown, political clashes, and growing radicalization — is Kerala really doing as well as it looks on paper? Or are we ignoring the cracks beneath the surface?

In this video, we break down the issues that mainstream narratives often skip. Watch till the end for a ground reality check on “God’s Own Country.”
